snippet.title: F.E.A.S.T. - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
F.E.A.S.T is a farming factory automation game focusing on cooking. You are a new recruit in a secret organization tasked with a critical mission: feed the gods before they destroy the world with their hunger. Farm ingredients, run food factories, and prepare gourmet-level offerings tailored to each divine being’s impossible appetite.

Features
* Farm, raise, and harvest: grow crops, care for animals, and gather ingredients under mounting pressure.
* Automate your kitchen-factory: design pipelines that handle everything from raw produce to five-star dishes, adjusting your systems on the fly as divine demands evolve.
* Cook gourmet meals with care: follow intricate recipes to craft meals inspired by global cuisines, tailored to each god’s unique palate.
* Offer your dishes on time:  deliver your creations to the shrines before time runs out… or suffer the consequences.

📌 Wishlist on Steam
